title: Councilmember Elo-Rivera and Community Partners Host Teralta Park Beautification Event
description: SAN DIEGO, CA – Councilmember Sean Elo-Rivera (District 9) joined residents, students, and community partners for a Teralta Park Beautification Day featuring tree planting, park furniture painting, and neighborhood revitalization efforts. The event marks a hands-on, community-driven start to the new year, with a focus on environmental justice, public space investment, and community pride in the heart of City Heights
